title: Dihuangzicao Granules Regulate the AGE/RAGE/NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway to Inhibit Inflammation in Psoriatic Mice via Network Pharmacology and Experimental Validation.
authors: Lyu, Chong; Qiao, Xianhua; Shi, Zhe; Gao, Juanjuan; Li, Xiao; Jiang, Shibin; Wang, Chengcheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药颗粒通过AGE/RAGE/NF-kB通路治疗银屑病，核心是疾病信号通路与药效验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIM: Psoriasis is an immune-mediated skin disease that occurs worldwide and is characterized by high prevalence and chronicity. Psoriasis has a complex pathogenesis and is difficult to cure. Therefore, continuous exploration of the pathogenesis of psoriasis and the search for new drug treatment methods are crucial for improving treatment efficiency and reducing psychological damage to psoriasis patients. The active ingredients in Dihuang Zicao granules (DHZCG) can effectively treat psoriasis. Therefore, this study aimed to analyze the active ingredients of DHZCG and their potential mechanisms for treating psoriasis. METHODS: The effective components of DHZCG were screened via the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform (TCMSP). Genetic information for psoriasis was retrieved from the GeneCards, OMIM and DisGENET databases. Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) analysis was performed, and component‒target‒disease networks were constructed. Important molecular biological processes and signaling pathways were screened via GO and KEGG analyses. Molecular docking of the active ingredients and key targets was performed via AutoDock Vina (1.1.2). A mouse model of psoriasis was established and divided into a control group, model group, low-dose DHZCG group (L-DHZCG), medium-dose DHZCG group (M-DHZCG), and high-dose DHZCG group (H-DHZCG). Hematoxylin and Eosin (HE) staining was performed to determine the pathological changes in the skin of each group of mice, and the Psoriasis Area Severity Index (PASI) score was used to assess skin damage. ELISA and RT‒ PCR were used to measure the levels of the inflammatory factors TNF-a, IL-17A, and IL-23 in the serum and skin tissue of the mice, respectively. Western blotting was used to analyze the expression of proteins related to the AGE/RAGE signaling pathway. Immunofluorescence was used to examine the expression of the inflammatory factor NF-kB. Immunohistochemistry was used to measure IL-1beta and TNF-a expression in skin tissues. RESULTS: Sixty genes associated with psoriasis treatment by DHZCG, including core genes encoding IL-6, TNF-a, AKT1, IL-1beta, TP53, NFKB1, BCL2, and MAPK3, were identified. Through the construction of a psoriasis mouse model, DHZCG treatment effectively reduced skin damage and significantly decreased the levels of the validated factors TNF-a, IL-17A, IL- 23, IL-1b, and NF-kB in the serum and damaged skin. Furthermore, the reduction in the levels of these inflammatory factors by DHZCG is associated with the downregulation of the AGE/RAGE signaling pathway. CONCLUSION: DHZCG reduces inflammation and alleviates psoriasis by downregulating the AGE/RAGE/NF-kB signaling pathway. This study is beneficial for providing a theoretical basis for the development of drugs for psoriasis and for offering personalized treatment strategies for the clinical management of psoriasis.
abstract_zh: 目的：银屑病是一种全球范围内发生的免疫介导性皮肤病，以高患病率和慢性化为特征。银屑病发病机制复杂且难以治愈。因此，持续探索银屑病的发病机制并寻找新的药物治疗方法，对于提高治疗效率和减少银屑病患者的心理损害至关重要。地黄紫草颗粒（DHZCG）中的活性成分能有效治疗银屑病。因此，本研究旨在分析DHZCG的活性成分及其治疗银屑病的潜在机制。方法：通过中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（TCMSP）筛选DHZCG的有效成分。从GeneCards、OMIM和DisGENET数据库中检索银屑病的遗传信息。进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）分析，并构建成分-靶点-疾病网络。通过GO和KEGG分析筛选重要的分子生物学过程和信号通路。使用AutoDock Vina（1.1.2）对活性成分和关键靶点进行分子对接。建立银屑病小鼠模型，并分为对照组、模型组、低剂量DHZCG组（L-DHZCG）、中剂量DHZCG组（M-DHZCG）和高剂量DHZCG组（H-DHZCG）。采用苏木精-伊红（HE）染色确定各组小鼠皮肤的病理变化，并使用银屑病面积和严重程度指数（PASI）评分评估皮肤损伤。采用ELISA和RT-PCR分别测量小鼠血清和皮肤组织中炎症因子TNF-a、IL-17A和IL-23的水平。使用Western blotting分析AGE/RAGE信号通路相关蛋白的表达。使用免疫荧光检测炎症因子NF-kB的表达。使用免疫组织化学测量皮肤组织中IL-1beta和TNF-a的表达。结果：鉴定出60个与DHZCG治疗银屑病相关的基因，包括编码IL-6、TNF-a、AKT1、IL-1beta、TP53、NFKB1、BCL2和MAPK3的核心基因。通过构建银屑病小鼠模型，DHZCG治疗有效减少了皮肤损伤，并显著降低了血清和受损皮肤中已验证因子TNF-a、IL-17A、IL-23、IL-1b和NF-kB的水平。此外，DHZCG降低这些炎症因子水平与AGE/RAGE信号通路的下调相关。结论：DHZCG通过下调AGE/RAGE/NF-kB信号通路减少炎症并缓解银屑病。本研究有助于为银屑病药物开发提供理论基础，并为银屑病的临床管理提供个性化治疗策略。
